requirements.text: Federation membership, ancestry and routing MUST NOT create Resolution Authority in another Context.
An exported artifact MUST preserve the exact source Context, target Context, scope and source policy generation of the active route under which the export is produced.
Member withdrawal MUST remain blocked while an active route involving that member exists.
Federation-profile transitions MUST be observational stutter with respect to the minimal Network admission state.
Activation of this profile MUST use the Seed-bound dynamic-profile mechanism; possession, verification or remote recognition of the profile MUST NOT activate it locally.
